title: That Time of the Year Again: Government Pay Revisions in the Aggregate Economy
abstract: arXiv:2611.12565v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Public pay is set by law in nominal terms, so inflation erodes its real value between legal acts until the government revises it. I model each revision as the choice of a forward-looking government, shaped by two costs that push in opposite directions. A fixed cost of acting makes revisions large and rare, whereas a convex cost of financing the increase at once makes them small and frequent. Through the budget, each revision also moves debt and the risk of fiscal stress under which the next one is made. In the documented pay decisions of eleven countries, pay set at discretion erodes against prices and private earnings and is restored in discrete steps, every cut was decided during market stress or an adjustment program, and court rulings drove a wedge between the cuts legislated, the cuts paid and the cuts that lasted. translated_title: 又到了一年一度的时刻：总体经济中的政府薪酬调整
translated_abstract: 公共部门的薪酬以名义形式由法律规定，因此在两次法律修订之间，通货膨胀会不断侵蚀其实际价值，直到政府对其进行调整。我将每次薪酬调整建模为一个具有前瞻性的政府所做出的选择，该选择受到两种方向相反的成本的塑造：行动的固定成本使得调整幅度大且频率低，而一次性为涨薪融资的凸性成本则使得调整幅度小且频率高。通过预算渠道，每次调整还会改变债务水平以及财政压力风险，而下一次调整正是在这种压力之下做出的。在十一个国家有据可查的薪酬决策中，由政府酌情设定的薪酬相对于物价和私人收入不断被侵蚀，并以离散的步骤得以恢复；每一次薪酬削减都是在市场承压时期或调整计划期间决定的；而法院裁决则在立法削减、实际支付削减与持久性削减之间造成了差异。基于法律条文的估计，该模型在大多数国家能够复现有据可查的薪酬路径，当数据与模拟（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文将政府薪酬调整建模为前瞻性政府面临“行动固定成本”与“融资凸性成本”两种相反力量下的选择，前者使调整大而稀少、后者使调整小而频繁，并用十一个国家的法律条文数据估计模型，成功复现了公共薪酬被通胀侵蚀并以离散步骤恢复的现实路径。
en_tdlr: This paper models government pay revisions as choices of a forward-looking government facing two opposing costs—a fixed cost of acting that makes revisions large and rare, and a convex financing cost that makes them small and frequent—and shows that the model, estimated on legal acts across eleven countries, reproduces the documented paths of public pay eroding with inflation and being restored in discrete steps.
